scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @coedit/server" "npm run dev -w @coedit/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @coedit/server && npm run build -w @coedit/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @coedit/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @coedit/server && npm run typecheck -w @coedit/web
